Name: Secret Garden Farmhouse (Unofficial Update)
Author: CyanFire
Description:
Update to Surrealo's Secret Garden Farmhouse which fixes up a few bugs and issues, such as layering, collision & warp issues.
Also fixes the bug where the farmhouse map changes back to vanilla at 1:10am.

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4736]DaisyNiko's Tilesheets[/url] & [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16507]Farmhouse Fixes[/url] to function correctly


If anyone experiences a floating tile in one of the rooms (tile 34, 9 for those fluent modders) after the second upgrade & after marriage, enable Remove Glitched Farmhouse/Cabin Tile in Farmhouse Fixes.


There is a config option to enable replacing Cabins too, this is set to false by default




Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17257]Permanent Cellar[/url]




[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13874]Original Mod[/url]
